topic: Data aggregation timing for inactive facilities
summary_markdown:
A forecasting issue was identified where the forecast failed to run for inactive facilities. The feature was disabled, and sessions were restored.

The main discussion centered on whether to reaggregate yesterday's data immediately or later in the evening. Concerns were raised about potential incorrect data being available on the platform if aggregation is delayed until closer to the evening.

A decision was made to run the aggregation now (immediately) to fix the results, and then communicate that the date corpus will be temporarily unavailable.
action_items: Communicate temporary unavailability of the date corpus after fixing.
